columns.name: major_incident_declared
columns.reason: Major-incident status is declared during ticket handling, so it is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: vendor_support_tier
columns.reason: Contractual vendor support tier is a standing attribute known when the ticket opens.

columns.name: data_class
columns.reason: Static data-classification attribute of the affected system.

columns.name: knowledge_article
columns.reason: Reads as the knowledge reference for the service or category, though it could instead be linked at resolution.

columns.name: sla_template
columns.reason: Applied at ticket creation from the contract and priority; it sets the clock but records nothing about the outcome.

columns.name: change_window
columns.reason: Scheduled change or maintenance window is known when the ticket is raised.

columns.name: ticket_source
columns.reason: Intake channel is recorded at ticket creation.

columns.name: reporting_pack
columns.reason: Reads as a standing reporting grouping for the contract rather than an outcome record.

columns.name: rack_group
columns.reason: Static physical placement attribute of the configuration item.

columns.name: chatops_channel
columns.reason: Standing chat channel for the service or support team, set independently of the ticket outcome.

columns.name: customer_exec_briefings
columns.reason: Executive briefings are delivered as the incident drags on and are only tallied afterwards.

columns.name: queue_group
columns.reason: Queue assignment is recorded at intake.

columns.name: os_class
columns.reason: Static configuration attribute of the affected host.

columns.name: change_freeze_flag
columns.reason: Freeze status is a calendar fact already known when the ticket opens.

columns.name: resolution_timestamp_delta_h
columns.reason: Time to resolution exists only after closure and is the quantity compared against the SLA to assign the label.

columns.name: timezone_band
columns.reason: Static coverage or location attribute.

columns.name: postmortem_actions_raised
columns.reason: Postmortem actions are raised after the ticket has been closed.

columns.name: runbook_ver
columns.reason: Version of the operational runbook in force, known at intake.

columns.name: db_engine
columns.reason: Static configuration attribute of the affected system.

columns.name: service_tier_index
columns.reason: Standing contractual service tier, fixed before the ticket is raised.

columns.name: deployment_tool
columns.reason: Static tooling attribute of the platform.

columns.name: platform_family
columns.reason: Static configuration attribute of the affected system.

columns.name: service_code
columns.reason: Service identifier recorded at ticket creation.

columns.name: shift_handover
columns.reason: Reads as the shift/handover arrangement covering the queue, though it could be a count accumulated during handling.

columns.name: language
columns.reason: Requester or ticket language is captured at intake.

columns.name: affected_user_count
columns.reason: Impact figure normally captured during intake triage, though it can be revised as the incident develops.

columns.name: escalation_priority_raised
columns.reason: Escalation occurs after the ticket is open and changes the priority clock used to judge the breach.

columns.name: contract_id
columns.reason: Customer contract identifier is fixed before the ticket exists.

columns.name: skill_group
columns.reason: Skill group is set when the ticket is routed at intake.

columns.name: escalation_matrix_ver
columns.reason: Version of the escalation policy in force is a standing configuration value.

columns.name: automation_flag
columns.reason: Reads as whether automation is enabled for this ticket type rather than an outcome record.

columns.name: queue_depth_at_open
columns.reason: Explicitly measured at ticket open, which is the prediction point.

columns.name: cost_centre
columns.reason: Static accounting attribute of the owning unit.

columns.name: sla_penalty_credit_usd
columns.reason: Service credits are calculated and issued only because a breach was recorded, so the value encodes the label.

columns.name: monitoring_tool
columns.reason: Static tooling attribute of the monitored service.

columns.name: datacentre
columns.reason: Static location attribute.

columns.name: middleware_ver
columns.reason: Static configuration attribute of the affected stack.

columns.name: cmdb_class
columns.reason: Static CMDB classification of the affected item.

columns.name: dr_tier
columns.reason: Standing disaster-recovery tier of the service.

columns.name: backup_class
columns.reason: Standing backup policy class of the configuration item.

columns.name: compliance_scope
columns.reason: Standing regulatory scope of the service.

columns.name: region
columns.reason: Static location attribute.

columns.name: dependency_depth
columns.reason: Topology depth taken from the CMDB graph, known before the ticket is worked.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.reason: Static organisational owner attribute.

columns.name: post_closure_reopen_count
columns.reason: Counts reopens that can only occur after the ticket is closed.

columns.name: paging_rota
columns.reason: Standing on-call rota assignment known at intake.
